name: Trade Data 15
definition: Provides information on the status of a trade.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Identification of the present message assigned by the party issuing the message. This identification must be unique amongst all messages of same type sent by the same party.

OriginatorReference.name: Originator Reference
OriginatorReference.definition: Represents the original reference of the instruction for which the status is given, as assigned by the participant that submitted the foreign exchange trade.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique system identification assigned to the trade by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchingReference.name: Matching System Matching Reference
MatchingSystemMatchingReference.definition: Unique matching identification assigned to the trade and to the matching trade from the counterparty by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.name: Matching System Matched Side Reference
MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.definition: Identification to the unique reference from the central settlement system that allows the removal of alleged trades once the matched status notification for the matching side has been received.

StatusOriginator.name: Status Originator
StatusOriginator.definition: Party that assigned the status to the foreign exchange or derivative trade.

CurrentStatus.name: Current Status
CurrentStatus.definition: Specifies the new status of a trade.

CurrentStatusSubType.name: Current Status Sub Type
CurrentStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the current status of a trade in a central system.

CurrentStatusDateTime.name: Current Status Date Time
CurrentStatusDateTime.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the current status was assigned.

PreviousStatus.name: Previous Status
PreviousStatus.definition: Specifies the previous status of a trade.

PreviousStatusSubType.name: Previous Status Sub Type
PreviousStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the previous status of a trade in a central system.

PreviousStatusDateTime.name: Previous Status Date Time
PreviousStatusDateTime.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the previous status was assigned.

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Specifies the product for which the status of the confirmation is reported.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS Settlement Session that the related trade is part of.

SplitTradeIndicator.name: Split Trade Indicator
SplitTradeIndicator.definition: To indicate if the trade is split.
